name: scale-200
purpose: 220 sources, 214 record types, 600 relationship types and 4,800 attempts over a year. Nothing on Home may grow because of any of it.
edge_cases: 220 sources and 214 record types: Home must render the same elements it does at five (S8).
4,800 attempts over a year, so the chart has a real rhythm and the Updates read needs a cursor (S6).
A blocked attempt carrying a forty-line recorded error, shown verbatim one level down.
One record with 500 relationships across six relationship types, capped at 100 per direction, so the Related tab must state the cap and the omitted count (S13).
600 relationship types, so Home's relationship-type list must bound itself.

invariant okg.cross_source.commit_author_resolves
